checkpoint_rule: minimum validation IC4 J = origin-macro ADE + 0.5 fixed-endpoint FDE4

decision_rule.pass: both seeds improve ADE, FDE4, and J; each of the six origin-cluster bootstrap 95% CIs is strictly positive; no convergence warning
decision_rule.conditional_pass: both-seed mean improves ADE, FDE4, and J and at least one seed improves all three, but a finite bootstrap or convergence confirmation remains

training.extension_rule: after both models reach the base phase, extend both symmetrically iff either model has best epoch >=29 and its last three validation IC4 J values strictly decrease
